title: Disjointness from a complementary subset
statement: Let $J$ and $U$ be subsets of the coordinate set $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $T$ be a set of coordinates belonging to $J$. If $U$ is contained in the complement of $J$, then the image of $T$ in the full coordinate set is disjoint from $U$.
hypotheses_covered: Subsets $J$ and $U$ of the coordinate set
$U$ is contained in the complement of $J$
